invariants.rationale: The method must return a valid List<WriteStatus>, not null, as per standard Java conventions for return values.
instantTime is used to identify the operation instant and is required to interact with the table and pre/post write routines.
records is passed in to perform the bulk insert, and it would not make sense to perform an insert with a null record set.
The method contract guarantees the result is a List of WriteStatus.
WriteStatus elements in the result list should be non-null to accurately reflect the success/failure of record writes.
